summary: Jasper County TX tower named Sheffield's Ferry, listed gone in the FFLA index; no history, staffing or site description found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists it as Tower Gone; no removal date or site description found

evidence.supports: County index lists the Sheffield's Ferry tower as Tower Gone
Statewide index lists the Sheffield's Ferry tower as Tower Gone

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA index mentions this tower, so the story is two sentences and well under the 120-word floor. It was not padded. Leads not used because they could not be read: a RootsWeb history of Sheffield's Ferry (sites.rootsweb.com/~txtcgs/JEFFSH~1.htm) returns HTTP 403 to both fetch_text and WebFetch, and no archived copy exists. A search snippet from that history describes a ferry built by Jeff Sheffield in the early 1900s, but it was not read, so nothing from it is used. A 2023 KJAS news item mentions a brush fire in the Sheffield Ferry area of west Jasper County; it is not about a tower and was not read. The Sheffield Ferry Boat Ramp Facebook page returned only its title. Needs a person with access to the RootsWeb history or Jasper County local history to check whether the tower stood at the ferry crossing. Budget used: 2 WebSearch, about 3 fetch_text reads, 1 WebFetch attempt, 1 archive lookup.
